title: Solar energy explained
content:
Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity.

How solar panels work

Solar cells convert light into an electrical current. Output depends on sunlight, the installation and the equipment used.

Practical limitations

Weather and shade affect output. A site assessment is needed to understand the limitations of a particular installation.
